in_sanskrit.name: Nehita
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nectar of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nehita एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nehita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neha', which means 'mind' or 'heart'. The suffix '-ita' denotes the one who embodies or possesses the qualities described by the prefix. Thus, Nehita is the one who embodies the nectar of the gods, symbolizing divine grace and spiritual purity.
